page_title: COM 1-2 FIO | Como v Fiorentina 14/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Fiorentina take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+2' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' The game has begun to heat up. Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
89' RED CARD! Alvaro Morata (Como) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Matteo Marchetti. He can have an early bath.
88' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) says more than he should have to the referee and is shown a yellow card.
88' Alvaro Morata (Como) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Matteo Marchetti's book.
86' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
84' Paolo Vanoli has decided to substitute Moise Kean and he is replaced by Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina).
84' The substitution is prepared. Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nicolo Fagioli.
82' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
80' Alvaro Morata (Como) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
79' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
79' Good work from Como as they win a corner.
77' 1 - 2 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it into the top right corner of his own goal.
75' The ball is cleared after Jayden Addai (Como) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
73' Alberto Moreno (Como) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
72' Here comes a substitution. Mergim Vojvoda is given a rest as he is replaced by Maxence Caqueret (Como).
70' Referee Matteo Marchetti has finally had enough of Paolo Vanoli and gives him a straight RED CARD!
69' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
67' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
66' Alvaro Morata (Como) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
65' Como can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

64' Marco Brescianini (Fiorentina) was too forceful with his tackle and Matteo Marchetti interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Como win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
62' 10:6 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
59' The free kick from long range, taken by Como, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
57' Here is a change. Anastasios Douvikas is going off and Cesc Fabregas gives the last tactical orders to Alvaro Morata (Como).
57' That will be all from Maximo Perrone who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jayden Addai (Como).

57' Martin Baturina (Como) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
56' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper.
54' 0 - 2 GOAL! That’s a perfect strike from the spot by Moise Kean (Fiorentina) into the top left hand corner, giving goalkeeper Jean Butez no chance!
53' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is going to take the penalty!
53' Maximo Perrone (Como) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. It's a penalty! What an opportunity to score for Fiorentina.
50' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) fires the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by one of his teammates.
49' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) has tested the patience of referee Matteo Marchetti and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
49' The Fiorentina players are exchanging some short passes.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
46' Half-time substitution. Cesc Fabregas decided to make a change. Alex Valle is replaced by Alberto Moreno (Como).
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Cesc Fabregas probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn. He is replaced by Jesus Rodriguez (Como).
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.

45' A pass across the box picks out an unmarked Martin Baturina (Como) and he tries to place the ball towards the roof of the net, but it goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.

42' What an opportunity! Nico Paz (Como) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes just wide of the left post!
40' Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) makes a strong challenge and Matteo Marchetti blows for a foul.

38' Nico Paz (Como) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
35' That's a well-taken pass by Nico Paz (Como). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
32' Nico Paz (Como) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
29' Como enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
26' 0 - 1 Goal! Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:1.
26' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
24' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
24' Jacobo Ramon (Como) commits a foul and Matteo Marchetti immediately signals a free kick.
22' Como are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
19' Nico Paz (Como) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but David de Gea easily deals with the threat.
18' Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
17' Fiorentina control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

15' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) rises above the defence to meet a cross from the corner. His timing is good, but he directs his header just a few inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
15' The ball goes out of play. Fiorentina are awarded a corner kick.

14' Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Fiorentina force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
10' Como hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
7' The referee blows his whistle as Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) was too aggressive in his challenge.
6' Great teamplay by Fiorentina as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
4' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Matteo Marchetti blows for a foul.
2' Como work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
1' Nico Paz (Como) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Como win a corner kick.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Como will take the kick-off.
Matteo Marchetti will officiate today.
